About the role

We are growing the customer success team and need someone who loves helping customers get value
from complex software. You will be the day-to-day contact for around 40 mid-market accounts.

Compensation: $85,000 - $95,000 a year, plus equity.

Requirements
- 3+ years in customer success or account management at a SaaS company
- Excellent written communication
- Comfort with data and dashboards
